events.title: Excessive bank below 500 ft
events.description: Bank angle below 500 ft, held 3 s. EASA Data4Safety, below 500 ft: more than 15 deg (SL2B) or 30 deg (SL3). Light aircraft: `bank-light`.
events.why_it_matters: Steep bank close to the ground raises the stall speed (about 7% at 20 deg, 41% at 45 deg) and risks a wingtip strike; a stall in a low turn is rarely recoverable.
events.advice: Plan the pattern so the turn to final is complete with shallow bank (15 deg or less) well above 500 ft. Overshooting final: go around, do not tighten the turn.
